chapter_name: Gifts of Grace: Honouring Our Vocations
learning_objective: 🎯 Understand the 'Dignity of Labour'. Learn that every job, whether big or small, contributes to society and deserves immense respect!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: No job is inferior or superior. A sweeper keeping the streets clean is just as important to society as a doctor curing patients. All honest work brings dignity.
When a person does their job with dedication, love, and honesty, their work becomes a form of art or a 'gift of grace'. It elevates mundane tasks into something beautiful.
Society runs smoothly because different people do different jobs. We rely on farmers for food, tailors for clothes, and teachers for knowledge. We are all interconnected.
We must appreciate the skill and hard work behind every profession. Recognizing someone's effort encourages them and builds a more respectful and equal society.

fun_activity.title: 🤝 Thank a Helper
fun_activity.instructions: Notice someone who does a 'simple' but essential job around you today—like the school guard, the sweeper, or the bus driver. Say a genuine 'Thank You' to them for their work!

exam_tips: 📌 Define the term 'Dignity of Labour' clearly with an example.
📌 Explain how different vocations function together like the gears of a clock to keep society running.
📌 Discuss why judging people based on their profession is harmful to social harmony.
quick_recap: ⭐ All honest work is a form of worship and service to humanity.
⭐ Doing your duty with perfection adds 'grace' to your life.
⭐ A healthy society respects the worker as much as it respects the work.
